Download **fitt.apk** for a new installation.

Already using an early development APK from this project? Use **fitt-legacy.apk** to update it without uninstalling or losing local data. Future in-app update prompts select the correct APK for your installed signing key.

Open the downloaded APK and approve Android's install/update confirmation. On some phones you must first allow APK installation from your browser or file manager. Do not uninstall Fitt to apply an update. Export a ZIP backup with photos before any manual device migration.

This release includes offline workouts and session recovery, 202 exercise entries, nutrition and diet schedules, progress charts, private progress photos, ZIP backup/restore, dark mode, optional Health Connect, and GitHub update prompts.

Automatic update checks contact GitHub at most once per day when Fitt is opened. No workouts, meals or photos are uploaded. Disable automatic checks in Settings if preferred. Downloads and installation require your action.

**SHA256SUMS.txt** contains asset checksums. This is an early release; please keep backups. Source code is visible, but an open-source license has not yet been selected.
